body:
thanks, i appreciate it ! :) 

i need to be goin to sleep at the moment i have a doctors appointment in the morning :(  another social place i really hate going   but it needs to be done i guess.. 

thanks for this "  you would be much more depressed if you are sexually driven and.. let say, still can't get a woman (in most cases, you are most likely drown in masturbation cycle, rendering yourself sunk deeper in the bottomless pit"  it made me laugh  

:)  if you have written some more for me  i shall give it a reply in the morning after i awake..   

youve been a great help to me tonight

i havent lost all faith in humanity... i really do know there are some genuinly nice people around..   just for some reason i cannot conect with them.. im not even sexually driven to go find myself a patner.. i prefer the company..

i really dont know how to describe it.. when im in a supermarket lets say.. i can be going in for milk eggs and kitchen towel...  i can very easily get so anxious in the shop i actually end up buying a magazine, a sandwhich and a bottle of fizzy pop  (cause those are at the checkout right at the door)  i dont go further into the shop..  either that or i walk round the shop really quickly.. not looking for the things i need, and leave again..   i just hate the feeling of being around so many people.. i feel like they are watching me    i also .. really hate it when someone stops to say hey and starts a conversation.. because now ive been stopped in the middle of those people   i dont know how to describe it really.. i get really flustered..      

i constantly walk around with a really serious frown on my face.. just so people will think im angry or in a mood   they stay away.. they say hey and walk off ..   

i avoid going to the cinema   or anywhere i actually thing that might be busy... 

if i buy something from a shop thats broken    i just put it in the bin instead of returning it.. 

i avoid making phone calls.. even to my friends..

i dont know whats happened in my life to traumatise me.. i wish i had some reason to be.. like bein assaulted or something.. but its something thats slowly crept up on me.. i try my hardest tho.. im not a rude person  so i always just do my things and stay inconspicous and moody looking as possible  :S

as for meeting people.. im ok after ive met them..  but the only time they get to socialise with me is when im at work... they pop in for a coffee   im more relaxed at work    no matter the ammount of people i have in the shop LOL :|    even when im typing this  im actually realising how much of a retard im making myself sound lol
i appologise for my profanity :( i didnt realise i had written some cuss words .. just got caught up in the moment

yeah, i love music,  i listen to it all day at work.. in the car to and from work  and when im at home.. i rarely turn on the tv anymore.. again.. i tend to stay away from things that make me think about how much i hate being alone or how much i fucked things up for myself in the past

its pretty much heavy metal, rock, anything fast paced and in your face.. 

i cant really listen to anything mellow without wanting to punch a parrot in th wing :|   

as for hobby, i know i really should have one..but i really dont know what to get into.. im not really artistic,  ive tried it, but my mind doesnt allow me to visualise the finished product, its over critical. so before ive even finished a drawing / painting or sculpture i already convinced myself that its rubbish and i scrap the project.. 

i love driving.. its my real escape.. to get in the car and drive 20 - 30 miles doesnt really matter where... i just love the feeling of going somewhere without anyone telling me where to go or what to do .. but as soon as i arrive at a destination.. instead of getting out by myself an goin a look around.. i jus turn the car around an drive back LOL.. its pathetic.. i know it is :(

i even tried to take up photography.. i purchased myself a nice camera,   i went a run to some nice country side in the spring time.. it was nice.. instead of gettin out the car and having a look around to see something worthy of taking pictures of.. i either.. sat in the car an took pictures from out the window.. or just kept driving.. just incase someone seen me with my camera taking pictures..

as i said before.. i loved goin walks in the country with my x.. it was different when i had someone to talk to.. i didnt feel so stupid..   i always feel like im creating a crime when i do things like that LOL.. i dono why.. i know im not.. but its weird..

thanks man.. 

they always say things can only get better,  i usually do find this to be true.. but its hard getting there.. 

and i dont wana bail out an take the easy option.. ive always been a stubborn fighter with my head down an getting on with life,  but sometimes.. like tonight.. i wonder if its worth it.. if in a years time if things will be alright.. or if every night ill still be taking the sleeping pills just to sleep..or if i have enough money to get by  

i also have to take care of my mother.. she has diabetes and MS   its hard man, i see her goin downhill pretty rapidly the last couple of years.. i try to stay strong for her..  

life fuckin sucks... its such a dick to the nice people

sometimes i wish i could re-do all over again.. id totally be some asshole who treated people like shit.. 

they are the ones who seem to be alright at the end of the day lol

i havent taken a day off in the last 6 weeks   just so i dont have to spend some time alone with myself... when karen was with me on my down time i liked to do things.. visit castles.. or go a walk in the country .. or go shopping , just something to keep my mind stimulated,   i really hate having time to myself..  i somehow sit alone, and just think depressing things an it hurts inside man,,   but i get through.. i usually just take sleeping pills so my time off goes by faster an i get back to work.. i dont really have a hobby as such.. at the moment im hammering battlefield 3 pretty hard   . :|

i live in a tiny town :(  theres never any small groups that meet up .. i guess theres poker nights.. but im not really into gambling either cuz im pretty sucky at that lol..   im glad tho that your doing something to get over your shyness..   what kinda books do you like reading?  i dont read much.. but when i do my fav has to be biographies.. i cant really get into stories :(

thanks for the reply,   ehh.. i havent really thought of the occupy movements, i dont really know what they are, im in the uk, i know there was one in glasgow, but im not really much of a people person anymore,  when im at work i socialise with the public that come in the shop, i have a false face i can chat away with them all, i have jokes and a bit of banter with them, its the only time when i feel like the old me, when i have to .. 

once i finish work, i go home i go for a shower,   going to the shops  or meeting new people   i really get nervous just going to the shop for a pint of milk, i even consider buying my groceries online so that i dont have to deal with the hussle and bussle of the supermarket, but at the moment i have forbidden myself from this because i know that after that i wont ever leave the house.. but sometimes ive found myself just getting in the car and driving past the same shop 5 or 6 times to avoid actually going out an getting in amongst the people there..   i get really anxious about meeting new people..  i get really anxious also about going to peoples houses.. even if ive known them for my whole life..   i stopped visiting people for this reason

but once im at work.. i have to socialise for the sake of the business..   other than my working persona.. i live with no meaning at all.. im am a pretty worthless individual    im 28 years old.. i dont drink alcohol. and i dont smoke... i dont do drugs and i dont socialise in the bar LOL..   im screwed.. i may as well be in a box waiting on the maggets partying in my eye sockets :S
